narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Top-of-the-Hour Bulletin"**

Central News borrows the graphics of a television news broadcast: a near-black broadcast bar across the top, flat red labels like a lower-third caption, and a running order of headlines keyed by time. Hierarchy comes from scale and weight, not from boxes. One story is told big; everything else is a dense, evenly ruled list a commuter can scan by time and source in a few seconds.

The surfaces are flat and square. White sheets sit on a cool grey ground, divided by 1dp hairlines rather than lifted as cards. Icon red (the launcher icon's red) is the only fill colour and is spent on small, high-signal pieces: the wordmark box, the source tag, the tab indicator, the time column, the primary action, and the selected states. Archivo carries every word, from ExtraBold headlines to small tracked uppercase labels.

Dark theme keeps the same structure: pure-black chrome, a near-black ground, and charcoal sheets. Red fills stay identical, while red used as text or icon tint shifts to a lighter coral so it stays readable.
keyCharacteristics: Broadcast chrome: a dark bar and pinned category tabs, continued into the status bar.
One fill colour (icon red), used sparingly and always on a clean sheet or as a solid block.
Flat white sheets on a grey ground, ruled by hairlines; no cards and no shadows.
Square corners on every brand element; Archivo throughout, with uppercase tracked labels.
Dense, time-first rows with 48dp touch targets that do not add height.

rules.name: The One Fill Rule
rules.body: Icon Red is the only fill colour. No secondary or tertiary accent exists; Material's secondary and tertiary slots map back to ink and red.

rules.name: The White Sheet Rule
rules.body: Red text and red icons sit only on a white sheet (light) or as Coral Red on a charcoal sheet (dark). Icon Red on the grey ground falls below AA, so any action that lands on the ground uses ink: the outlined secondary button, for example.

rules.name: The Untinted Surface Rule
rules.body: Material's surface tint is turned off (transparent). Elevated Material surfaces stay neutral; without this, dark sheets pick up a brown cast from the red.

rules.name: The Caps Are Labels Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is for the wordmark, screen titles, source names and time bugs. Headlines and body copy stay in sentence case.

rules.name: The Extra Line Rule
rules.body: When the system font scale is above 1.15, headlines get one extra line so they cut at a word, not mid-word.

rules.name: The 48dp Beside Rule
rules.body: Every touch target is at least 48dp, but trailing actions sit beside the whole row, centred vertically, so they never add a line of height.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Surfaces separate by tone and hairline, never by shadow or by tinted elevation.

dos: **Do** use brand-red as the only fill colour, and keep red text and red icons on white sheets (Coral Red brand-red-on-dark in dark theme).
**Do** separate content with flat sheets, the ground colour, and 1dp hairlines inset 16dp.
**Do** keep brand elements square (0dp): tags, bugs, the wordmark box, indicators, and photos.
**Do** set the wordmark, screen titles, source names and time bugs in uppercase tracked Archivo, and headlines in sentence case.
**Do** show both the source and the age wherever a headline appears, with times in tabular figures.
**Do** place 48dp trailing actions beside the whole row so they never add height.
**Do** keep surfaceTint transparent on every Material scheme.
donts: **Don't** put brand-red text or icons on the ground (#F2F3F5); at 4.46:1 it fails AA. Use ink.
**Don't** add shadows, tonal elevation, or rounded cards to feed content.
**Don't** introduce a second accent colour or a gradient.
**Don't** place a red label above a headline on its own. The source tag sits above a headline only as a lower-third on a photo's edge; otherwise it follows the headline.
**Don't** use Material's ScrollableTabRow for the category tabs; it forces 90dp tabs.
